title: CIVITA Experimental Geometries Schema
description: Defines experimental geometry instances using versioned parametrizations from the common CIVITA geometry library.

metadata.title: CIVITA Experimental Geometries Schema
metadata.description: Defines experimental geometry instances using versioned parametrizations from the common CIVITA geometry library.

$comment: Use x-civita-geometry-library to resolve the exact geometry_type_id and geometry_type_version. Apply the required parameter names, bounds, and compatibility rules from that version as described in concrete-experimental-database-vocab/README.md#geometry-instances.

geometry_id.description: Local identifier for this geometry instance in the Experimental Database.

source_id.description: Identifier of the literature source associated with this geometry instance.

geometry_type_id.description: Global identifier of the geometry type in the common CIVITA geometry library.

geometry_type_version.description: Version of the referenced geometry type, expressed as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

parameters.description: Embedded numerical parameter values in the canonical units of the referenced geometry type version.

notes.description: Additional information about the geometry instance.
